_note: How Cubbie finds a store's public shelf price (Tier 2). Checked 2026-10-24 by one plain fetch per site from a dev machine, not from Cubbie's browser; 'checked' records only what that fetch saw. No API keys, tokens or private endpoints. 'status' is blocked, loaded or unverified (blocked: one try in Cubbie's browser, then Tier 3). One try per store; a robot check, sign-in wall or sign-in location prompt means: mark the store blocked and move on.

Aldi.search: search the web for "aldi.us <item>"; product pages look like https://www.aldi.us/product/<name>-<id>
Aldi.quirks: A web search snippet for an aldi.us product page said prices online may vary from those in store. Label shelf prices from aldi.us as online prices.
Aldi.checked: 2026-10-24: https://www.aldi.us/results?q=eggs gave 404; a product page fetch returned an empty template (page builds with JavaScript). unverified

generic.search: search the web for "<store> <item> price <ZIP>", then open the store's own public product page
generic.pick_store: If the page asks for a ZIP or store without sign-in, enter the student's ZIP. If it needs sign-in, stop.
generic.quirks: Read only the shown price, package size and unit, the store or "online price" label, and the page address. Ignore prices on third-party sites (news, blogs, deal sites).
